decision_rule: NO-GO if any no_go_criteria triggers, regardless of sample size.
INCONCLUSIVE if sample_requirements are not met and no no_go criterion triggers.
GO only if sample_requirements are met and every go_criterion passes.
INCONCLUSIVE otherwise (some GO criteria unmet, none hard-failing).

go_criteria.description: Net compounded return on the primary scenario must be positive.
Bootstrap 95% lower bound of the compounded return must be positive.
Monetary profit factor must be at least 1.10.
Hourly mark-to-market max drawdown must be no worse than -30%.
At least 3 of 5+ folds must have a positive compounded return.
No single fold may explain more than 60% of net P&L.
Return after removing the 5 best trades must stay positive.
Every selected threshold must belong to the pre-registered grid.
No anti-reuse, boundary or hash violation may occur.

no_go_criteria.description: A non-positive net return is an automatic NO-GO.
A monetary profit factor below 1.0 is an automatic NO-GO.
A mark-to-market drawdown worse than -40% is an automatic NO-GO.
A non-positive return without the 5 best trades is an automatic NO-GO.
Two or fewer positive folds is an automatic NO-GO.
Any anti-reuse, boundary or hash violation is an automatic NO-GO.

note: Criteria are fixed before independent data exists. They are deliberately stricter than a repeat of the research result. They cannot be relaxed after seeing independent data; relaxing them requires a new protocol version and a new independent period, and the old version remains archived as NO-GO.
